svg.data-power-current-max: 7 A at 100 VAC; 2.9 A at 230 VAC
svg.data-cooling: two built-in fans and a third in the power supply, side-to-rear
svg.data-optics-sfp: hardware guide, Uplink Ports: the four uplink ports take 1-gigabit SFP transceivers, fibre or copper, and can be configured as Virtual Chassis ports
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to four EX2200 switches, including EX2200-C, from Junos OS 12.2
